prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. depth.jpg, segmentation.jpg and pose.jpg are the same 5 frames rendered as a monocular depth map (brighter = nearer to the camera wearer), an instance segmentation map (coloured masks with class labels), and a body/hand skeleton map (yellow = body, magenta = hands) on black. Look at all four images. For EACH of the three maps, describe the spatial understanding that map supports, using the RGB strip for context: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Say what each map shows that is hard to see in the RGB alone, and where the map looks unreliable. Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"depth": "...", "segmentation": "...", "pose": "..."} with 3-5 sentences each.

descriptions.depth: The depth map separates the near balcony structure and foliage from the courtyard below: leaves, railings, and the camera wearer’s visible limbs are bright and close, while the ground is darker and roughly 2–4 m below/in front of the camera. Across frames 1–2, nearby leaves and ledges occupy the upper and left areas at about 0.3–1.5 m, with small courtyard objects several metres farther away; across frames 3–4, a forearm extends from the lower foreground toward the right-hand railing, placing both within roughly 0.2–0.8 m and partly occluding the wall and floor behind. In frame 5, a raised leg dominates the centre-right foreground, extending upward and partly out of view at approximately 0.1–0.8 m, while the railing and courtyard remain behind it. This map makes front-to-back separation and the limbs’ closeness clearer than RGB, but its absolute metre estimates, black background regions, foliage boundaries, and depths along thin rails and limb edges appear unreliable.
descriptions.segmentation: The segmentation map identifies a large bench-like region on the left of frame 1, small distant objects near the upper-left courtyard edge, and person regions corresponding to the camera wearer’s exposed arm or leg in frames 3–5; no complete second person is distinctly segmented. The person mask moves from a bent, mostly horizontal foreground arm in frame 3 to a similar arm farther right in frame 4, then to a tall near-vertical leg in frame 5, with each limb partly cut off by the bottom or top image boundary and overlapping the railing or background. The labelled objects in frames 1–2 are several metres beyond the wearer, whereas the person masks are within arm’s reach, roughly 0.1–0.8 m from the camera; distances among the distant small objects cannot be recovered reliably from segmentation alone. The masks clarify object extents and occlusions against the cluttered RGB scene, but labels such as “boat” and “laptop” appear inconsistent with the visible construction/courtyard objects, and most railings, walls, plants, and ground are unlabelled.
descriptions.pose: The pose map is entirely black in all five frames, so it provides no detected body or hand joints, facing direction, gaze direction, reach geometry, or inter-person distances. It therefore cannot determine whether any person faces or looks toward the camera wearer, and it adds no evidence about approach, retreat, or turning across time. Relative to the RGB and other maps, the visible foreground arm in frames 3–4 and raised leg in frame 5 should occupy near-camera space, but none of these limbs receives a skeleton and any other people remain undetected. The blank output is unreliable for this sequence, likely because only partial, strongly foreshortened limbs are visible and much of each body lies outside the frame.
